title: Object Store Configuration
description: Optional object-store.yaml in the config home: where storage/v1 artifact bytes live. storage/v1 records only each artifact's digest and byte size; the bytes are kept in this object store under <prefix>sha256/<digest>. Holds no credentials; they come from the environment or the workload's identity, so the file is safe to commit. Absence means artifact bytes are not retained and typed reads are unavailable.

backend.description: Object store protocol. s3 covers AWS S3 and S3-compatible stores (ODF/Ceph RGW, MinIO).

endpoint.description: host[:port] of an S3-compatible endpoint, without a scheme. Omit for AWS S3.

region.description: Bucket region. Required when endpoint is omitted (AWS S3).

prefix.description: Key prefix ending in /, e.g. prod/, so several environments can share a bucket.

tls.description: Use TLS. Disable only for local test endpoints.

mode.description: Server-side encryption for written objects. bucket-default leaves it to the bucket policy.

kms_key_id.description: KMS key id or ARN; required for sse-kms.

max_object_bytes.description: Largest artifact a reader will accept. Readers default to 64 MiB.
